title: Apple Releases tvOS 27.2.1 With Siri AI for Older Apple TVs
content:
Apple today released tvOS 27.2.1, an update to the tvOS 27 operating system that launched in September. tvOS 27.2.1 comes nearly three weeks after Apple released tvOS 27.2.


tvOS 27.2.1 brings Siri AI support to the 2nd- and 3rd-generation Apple TV 4K models, but it is available for all ‌Apple TV‌ 4K models that support tvOS 27.

Apple announced ‌Siri‌ AI for the ‌Apple TV‌ when debuting the 4th-generation ‌Apple TV‌ 4K. A separate tvOS 27.2 build activates ‌Siri‌ AI on the newest set-top box, but the older ‌Apple TV‌ 4K models will need the tvOS 27.2.1 update to get access.

‌Siri‌ AI is the smarter, more capable version of ‌Siri‌ that Apple introduced earlier this year. ‌Siri‌ AI can play content, draw on personal context to offer suggestions, answer world knowledge questions, and complete tasks.

Using ‌Siri‌ AI on the ‌Apple TV‌ requires a paired Apple Intelligence-compatible iOS device, which includes the iPhone 15 Pro and later.

‌Apple TV‌ users can download tvOS 27.2.1 by going to Settings > System > Software Update. Apple has also released a new HomePod Software 27.2.1 update for the ‌HomePod‌ and ‌HomePod‌ mini.
